title: Triggers
description: Watch directories for new or modified files and automatically run archive actions, module capabilities or pipelines.
table.name: Name
empty.title: No trigger rules yet
empty.description: Create a rule to monitor a directory and process incoming files automatically.
delete.title: Delete rule
delete.message: Delete trigger rule "{{name}}"? Watched files will no longer be processed. This action cannot be undone.
toggle.disabledHint: Disabled rules are skipped by the watch loop
history.title: Trigger history
dialog.name: Name
dialog.watchDirHint: Absolute path. The directory may not exist yet; a warning is logged until it appears.
dialog.extensionsHint: Comma separated. Dots are stripped and values lowercased. Leave empty to accept all files.
dialog.recursiveHint: Recursively scan subdirectories under the watch directory.
dialog.includeModifiedHint: When off, only new files trigger; changes to already-seen files never trigger.
dialog.stabilityHint: A file must stay unchanged for this long before it triggers (minimum 5s). Prevents half-written downloads.
dialog.backfillHint: When on, files already in the directory are processed oldest-first. When off, only files arriving after creation trigger.
dialog.enabledHint: Disabled rules are skipped by the watch loop.
dialog.mode.archiveDesc: Copy matching files to the output directory with the naming template. No module or pipeline needed.
dialog.mode.moduleDesc: Run a module capability on each file, then archive the result.
dialog.mode.pipelineDesc: Submit the selected pipeline with the file injected at the chosen input node.
dialog.inputNodeNone: This pipeline has no file input node
dialog.inputNodeHint: Files are injected at the selected file_input node.
dialog.outputHint: Matched files (or direct-action results) are delivered to the output directory with the naming template.
validation.watchDirAbsolute: Watch directory must be an absolute path
validation.pipelineRequired: Select a pipeline and input node
validation.destDirAbsolute: Destination directory must be an absolute path
